head: Ring Drone Cam: $249.99 indoor security drone ships 27 January
dek: Amazon's Ring is selling the Drone Cam, a small indoor drone with cameras that patrols your home, for $249.99, shipping on 27 January 2027. Ring also announced the Rover Cam.
details: The Drone Cam weighs 165 grams and has a 2K camera on the front and a 1080p camera underneath, with lights. It can fly on a schedule or when a motion or leak sensor goes off, or you can start a flight yourself.
means: A home security camera can now move from room to room instead of staying in one spot.
todo: If you're interested, read Ring's privacy settings for the drone before you buy.
